description: Which Japanese corporate numbers could this organization name refer to? Searches the National Tax Agency (NTA) Web-API by name (prefix match after the legal form, with the NTA's fuzzy matching), optionally within a prefecture, and returns every candidate with corporate number, name, location and recorded closure date, marked exact_name or fuzzy_candidate. Never picks one for you. Carries the NTA Web-API source statement. Not an official result.

limit.description: Number of candidates to detail, 1-50 (default 20). candidate_corporate_numbers lists all of them (up to 200).

name.description: Organization name in Japanese, 1-100 characters, e.g. 国税庁 or a company name. The legal form (株式会社 etc.) is removed before the prefix search.

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture code 01-47 (e.g. 13) or name (Tokyo or 東京都) to narrow the search to that prefecture.

name: nta_corporate_number_search

attribution.description: Required source statement of the NTA Corporate Number System Web-API terms (Article 6; source_statement_ja is the required wording), the source notice with the retrieval date, and the statement that this is processed by MK Career Planning and is not an official government result. Keep it when you pass results on.

candidate_corporate_numbers.description: Every candidate's corporate number kept by this service (up to 200), including those not detailed in candidates (never collapsed to one).

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: candidates_found / no_candidates_found / unknown (see unknown_reason). A failure is never reported as no candidates.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

total.description: Number of organizations the NTA counted for this search.

title: Corporate number candidates for an organization name (NTA)
